text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fateful day of the Sprinters Stakes 
had finally arrived. During the opening 
ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The all-star video proposed by Curren Chan 
was broadcast, rousing excitement in the 
venue on par with the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cuteness of Hishi Akebono, Taiki 
Shuttle, and Sakura Bakushin O in the 
special opening video doubled the 
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now, the climactic showdown. Even Curren 
Chan couldn't hide her nerves, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by her Trainer's one-of-a-kind 
words, "You're cute today too," she headed 
to the race with a fulfilled expression.
